## A simple example

The exponential density is $f(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}$ for $x\geq 0$.

```{python}
#| label: fig-exponential
#| fig-cap: "Exponential densities for three rate parameters."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

# Resolve the style from either a post folder or the repository root.
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / "_quarto.yml").exists())
plt.style.use(root / "assets/design/leo.mplstyle")
x = np.linspace(0, 5, 300)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for rate in [0.5, 1, 2]:
  ax.plot(x, rate * np.exp(-rate * x), label=fr"$\lambda={rate}$")
ax.set(xlabel="x", ylabel="Density")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.show()
```
